gloss: strikingly beautiful; having a fine appearance

definitions.gloss: strikingly beautiful; having graceful features and figure
definitions.explanation: Describes a person whose face and overall appearance are exceptionally beautiful and elegant. A formal, literary expression often used in writing.

examples.japanese: {容姿端麗|ようしたんれい}な⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧だ。
examples.english: She is a strikingly beautiful woman.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{容姿端麗|ようしたんれい}で⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{優秀|ゆうしゅう}→優秀：03646_yuushuu⟧だ。
examples.english: He is good-looking and has excellent grades.

examples.japanese: {容姿端麗|ようしたんれい}な⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧、⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
examples.english: Not only is she strikingly beautiful, but she also has a wonderful personality.

notes:
USAGE:
A ⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧ (four-character compound) that describes someone with outstanding physical beauty. ⟦{容姿|ようし}→容姿：12293_youshi⟧ means appearance or figure, and ⟦{端麗|たんれい}→端麗：18941_tanrei⟧ means graceful or refined. Used as a na-adjective modifying nouns ({容姿端麗|ようしたんれい}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧) or as a predicate. More formal and literary than simply saying ⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧ or ⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {容姿端麗|ようしたんれい}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a strikingly beautiful person)
- {頭脳明晰|ずのうめいせき}{容姿端麗|ようしたんれい} (brilliant mind and beautiful appearance)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{美人|びじん}→美人：01600_bijin⟧: a beautiful person — more everyday and casual
- ⟦{端正|たんせい}→端正：14887_tansei⟧な: well-proportioned, refined — describes neat, balanced features
